name: curiousbees-monorepo
description: CuriousBees V2 — Institutional Academic Research Collaboration, Ph.D. Supervision & Governance Platform

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/types && npm run build --workspace=packages/constants && npm run build --workspace=packages/shared-utils
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:reset && npm run db:seed
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/.next apps/*/dist packages/*/dist
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run setup
scripts.team:reset: npm run db:setup && npm run clean && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run setup
